also.what: Dynamic Table, the dropdowns (the sort field and the filters' selects)

infoAttributes.content: Custom attributes will be added to the most relevant HTML node.

rows.label: Rows
rows.description: One row per line, commas between cells.

headerRow.label: Header row
headerRow.description: Its cells head columns with no heading.

key.label: Value
key.description: Column number, field name or dynamic tag.

ddBackground.label: Background
ddBackground.description: The sort field and the filters' selects alike.

filterRow.label: On their own row
filterRow.description: Otherwise they share the search row.

colMin.label: Minimum column width
colMin.description: Below it the table scrolls sideways, not squeezes.

headerSit.label: Text and icon sit
headerSit.description: Apart: the text first, the icon last.

headerBorder.label: Border
headerBorder.description: A 2px line under it until you set this.

sortIcon.label: Icon
sortIcon.description: Two arrows until you choose one; it turns for ascending.

cellBorder.label: Border
cellBorder.description: Every cell; a side set here replaces the row's.

rowBorder.label: Border
rowBorder.description: A 1px line under each row until you set this.

bfbeHoverOn.label: Responds to
bfbeHoverOn.description: The parent needs Children respond to hover.

bfbeHoverDelay.label: Delay
bfbeHoverDelay.description: Milliseconds, so parts arrive in sequence.

bfbeHoverScope.label: Children respond to hover
bfbeHoverScope.description: Parts inside set to A hovered parent move.

bfbeHsOver.label: Over the first section
bfbeHsOver.description: Only with the header over the first section.

bfbeHsDelay.label: Delay
bfbeHsDelay.description: Milliseconds, scrolling down only, so parts arrive in sequence.
